static_traits.name: Chen Bowen
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, no immediate family mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with friends; has a few close friends but unwilling to discuss writing unease
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no prior psychotherapy or psychiatric treatment; never had similar Self-doubt problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, highly cooperative, cautious tone; able to identify and describe automatic thoughts, Willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I am a terrible writer because my last romance novel was poorly received, which led to Self-doubt and a sense of incompetence.
basic_info.core_demands: Negative feedback has significantly affected my self-esteem and enthusiasm for writing, prompting me to seek counseling support; I want to come out of it and enjoy writing again.
growth_experiences: Six months ago, my last romance novel received mostly negative feedback, focused on plot and character Shaping; having invested much time and passion, the feedback brought intense stress and Sense of frustration. Since then, whenever sitting down to write or thinking about a writing career, Self-doubt of 'I am not good enough / I am a bad writer' and avoidance quickly arise.

special_situations.event: Sits down to start writing or thinks about one's writing career
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one work fails, it proves I am overall a failed writer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing or avoiding starting to write; trying to make up for 'inadequate ability' by taking online courses
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Why bother? It will be as bad as the last one.

special_situations.event: Recalling the negative feedback received on the previous romance novel six months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' evaluations determine my writing worth and ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly concerned with external evaluation, reduces discussing writing with friends to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I disappointed the readers; I am just a poor author.

special_situations.event: Communication with friends involves writing or ability topics
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not approve of my writing, it means I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding talking about writing, not actively sharing work to avoid negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If they do not approve of my writing, it means I am incompetent.

special_situations.event: At the thought of writing, generalizing the last work's failure to all future creations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure means I will always fail in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops or delays writing to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The last work failed, meaning I am doomed to fail every time.

core_conflict.wish: Longs for works to be liked, hopes to be recognized and have writing ability affirmed
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated, worrying others' evaluations will hurt self-esteem
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of failing again and Anxiety through Self-deprecation and avoiding writing
Reduces discussing writing with others to avoid criticism and humiliation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share works or discuss writing ability, or when recalling negative feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The other person will negate me as harshly as readers did; I will be humiliated (projective expectation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using Self-deprecating expressions, in a hesitant and self-blaming tone; lowering self-evaluation, avoiding directly asking others for feedback or quickly ending related topics.

manifestations: After the last work failed, passion for writing declined, feeling writing 'has no meaning'
The 'why bother' experience when sitting down to write
Unwilling to discuss writing unease with friends, relationships becoming tense

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial in conversation (equating one failure with 'I am a bad writer')
Being overly cautious when writing topics come up, unwilling to elaborate for fear of being judged

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Taking readers' negative feedback directly as the sole measure of one's own ability
Believes 'one must write works that everyone likes to count as qualified'

exception_events.target_problem: When sitting down to write, the client usually immediately engages in Self-denial and therefore avoids or stops writing.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Just a few days ago, he tried starting a new story; although negative thoughts appeared, he did not give up right away.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: choosing to act despite emotional setbacks, trying to start rather than fully avoiding.

exception_events.target_problem: When facing others' evaluations, the client usually sees negative feedback as a total negation of self-worth, thereby lowering writing motivation.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Past works received readers' liking and positive feedback, showing he is not always a failure.
exception_events.reason: Different understanding: past success experiences as evidence, supporting a more balanced view of my abilities.

positive_force: Once had work liked by readers
Willing to accept counseling and participate in cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
Completed an online writing course with learning gains
Stable work performance, basic life structure present
negative_force: Overgeneralizing a single failure, Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking
Excessively relies on external evaluation to determine self-worth
Unwillingness to express unease to friends means support cannot be effectively used
Shame and Anxiety triggered by negative feedback

target_behavior.behavior: Immediate Self-denial and writing avoidance in writing situations
antecedent: Recalls negative feedback or reader criticism of the last work
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one failure and Introjecting external evaluations as self-worth, forming catastrophizing and black-and-white cognition, self-sabotaging to avoid failing again
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible failure and negative emotions, briefly reducing Anxiety and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Writer's block, hindered Career development, Low mood, Tense relationships with friends
